model: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), running as a Claude Code subagent
independence: Graded without reading any other grader output. No person has reviewed these grades.
method: RAG: each shown block was read against the full text of every section it cites; a case passes when its shown status is allowed by expected.statuses and every block is supported, or when it is an allowed abstention, an expected-matching proposal, or the expected HTTP error with no model call. Drafts rejected by the guard were not shown to users and are not graded as claims. references_any is reported separately as references_any_met and does not change 'passed'. Discovery: each suggestion reason was read against each cited section. Planner text: suggestion reasons and clarification questions and labels; fixed notices excluded.
